title: Mushkil ko meri hal karo
body:
Aye kul ke madadgar
sardaro ke sardaar
mushkil kushayi ho
mere maula mere sarkaar
gar tum na karoge to karam kaun karega?
gar tum na sunoge to meri kaun sunega?
meri kaun sunega?
<<MINI>>
Zahra ki musibat ka tumhe waasta Ali
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
Zahra ki musibat ka tumhe waasta Ali
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Maula meri nigaho ko hasil ho ye sharaf
jiteji ek baar dikha do mujhe najaf
dikha do mujhe najaf
saanso ka ruk na jaye...
saanso ka ruk na jaye kahi silsala Ali
<<MINI>>
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mushkil ghadi hai kijiye aasan raaste
sab par karam ho bali sakina ke waaste
sakina ke waaste
tum bin nahi hai...
tum bin nahi hai koi mera aasra Ali
<<MINI>>
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aye kibriya ki shaan Mohammad ke dilnashee'n
aansu rawa hai aankh se dil ko sukoo'n nahi
dil ko sukoo'n nahi
ye dil se aa rahi hai...
ye dil se aa rahi hai musalsal sadaa Ali
<<MINI>>
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
Zahra ki musibat ka tumhe waasta Ali
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ek ghar mujhe bhi chahiye kaabe ke mohtaram
jis par laga ho hazrat e abbas ka alam
abbas ka alam
ghurbat mein muflisi mein..
ghurbat mein muflisi mein yehi hai dua Ali
<<MINI>>
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Beemar e karbala se wafa ka sila mile
beemar jo hai unko mukammal shifa mile
mukammal shifa mile
uski qasam jo...
uski qasam jo kaato'n pe chalta rahi Ali
<<MINI>>
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haye hussain haye zaeefi ka wo samaa
dekhi jawaan bete ke seene me jab sina
seene me jab sina
rakh kar sina pe..
rakh kar sina pe haath tadap kar kaha Ali
<<MINI>>
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
Zahra ki musibat ka tumhe waasta Ali
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jis dum aseer hoke chali shaam ke taraf
zainab pukari dekh ke haye sue najaf
haye sue najaf
kis tarha shaam...
kis tarha shaam jaungi mai berida Ali
<<MINI>>
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Zindaa'n mein jab behen ka janaza na uth saka
haye tadap ke sayyed e sajjad ne kaha
sajjad ne kaha
waqt e madad hai..
waqt e madad hai aaiye ya murtaza Ali
<<MINI>>
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Zeeshan aur Raza ke labo par dua hai yeh
ghaibat se jald barwe bete ko bhejiye
bete ko bhejiye
mushkil hai saans lena...
mushkil hai saans lena ab unke bina Ali
<<MINI>>
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
Zahra ki musibat ka tumhe waasta Ali
Mushkil ko meri hal karo, mushkil kusha Ali
